purpose: Present the evidence and legal-source basis of a published citizen-facing answer in an understandable layered view, without exposing internal reasoning or unsupported material.

layers.purpose: State the supported conclusion in plain language.
Show the material evidence and authority supporting the conclusion without exposing hidden reasoning.
Distinguish observed official-record facts from interpretation.
Identify the applicable legal source and proposition.
Give the appropriate official route when action is required.

display_rules: Lead with the answer rather than the research machinery.
Show only material evidence needed to understand the answer.
Allow deeper source inspection through official-source references.
Keep factual observations visually distinct from legal propositions.
Display relevant dates when temporal scope matters.
Display limitations prominently enough that they cannot be mistaken for footnotes.
Do not expose hidden chain-of-thought or private reasoning.
Do not display an internal confidence score as a substitute for evidence status.
hard_stops: Never imply that a citation alone proves the conclusion.
Never hide a material limitation behind a collapsed or secondary interface.
Never expose internal reasoning traces that are not appropriate for public presentation.
Never substitute an internal score for the underlying source and evidence.
Never show an official route as if it were a completed action.
